jobs.Position Overview: This Intelligence Analyst position provides critical intelligence analysis support to the 480th ISR Wing at Langley Air Force Base. The role involves conducting comprehensive all-source intelligence analysis, preparing various intelligence products for leadership consumption, and delivering briefings to senior military leadership. The analyst will play a key role in supporting Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) mission planning and execution activities, contributing to the wing's operational effectiveness and mission success.
Key Responsibilities: Conduct all-source intelligence analysis using multiple intelligence disciplines
Prepare intelligence products for leadership review and decision-making
Brief senior leadership on intelligence findings and assessments
Analyze intelligence data from various sources and platforms
Maintain situational awareness of operational environments
Collaborate with intelligence teams and operational units
Required Qualifications: Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph
Understanding of ISR operations and mission planning
Experience working in military or defense intelligence environment

jobs.Position Overview: This DevSecOps Engineer position supports the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. The role focuses on implementing DevSecOps pipelines, automating testing and deployment processes, and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure. The engineer will work within DoD software development environments, with preferred experience in Platform One and DoD software factories to support mission-critical intelligence operations.
Key Responsibilities: Implement DevSecOps pipelines for software development lifecycle
Support Platform One environments and DoD software factories
Integrate security practices into development workflows
Collaborate with development teams on automated solutions
Required Qualifications: Experience with DevSecOps methodologies and practices
Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance
Experience with GitLab for version control and CI/CD
Ansible automation and configuration management skills
Understanding of DoD software development environments
